Subject: November pipeline hygiene: commit readiness + leadership pack action items

Team —

Quick reminder as we enter the month close and prep for the leadership review: please treat this as the official call for pipeline hygiene and commit readiness. High level asks below (short and actionable):

1) HubSpot stage accuracy: update stage, forecast category, and expected close date for every open opportunity you own (focus on deals > $50k).
2) Commit flag: mark any deal you intend to include in the November commit with the custom field "Month Commit" = Nov-2026 and set probability.
3) Leadership pack: I attached the latest leadership_pack_template_v2.pptx — fill the single-slide ask per committed deal (deal summary, key risks, mitigation, expected ARR). Put completed slides into the Drive folder by EOD Nov 10.
4) Exceptions & escalations: if you need a one-time SLA/credit or have procurement blockers, flag here and include the deal_id and contacts.

Links: leadership pack folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bLeadPack
HubSpot deals view: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deals

Meeting: we'll do a short commit review on Nov 11, 11am PT (30 min). Please have your slides and HubSpot cleaned before the meeting.

Why this matters: clean stages = accurate forecasting + fewer surprises. I need every manager to own this process; please confirm by EOD tomorrow that your team is aligned.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
